lines.text: Many learners say: The price is expensive.
Things are expensive. Price is high.
High! The price of this bag is high.

data.why: Things are expensive. Price is high.

quiz.stem: The price of this bag is ___.

native.tip: Kita bilang “harganya mahal”. Di bahasa Inggris, barangnya expensive, tapi harga (price) itu high.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “The price is expensive.” 😅 Barang itu expensive, harga itu high: “The price is high.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “high”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “The price is high.” lalu tulis satu barang yang menurutmu mahal. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “harganya mahal”. In English, a thing is expensive, but the price is high.
en.caption: Ever say this? “The price is expensive.” 😅 A thing is expensive, the price is high: “The price is high.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
